ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in the Minnesota Medicaid system to identify potential areas of fraud
questions: How are Medicaid funds being allocated in Minnesota?
What are the potential vulnerabilities in the system?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the flow of funds in the Minnesota Medicaid system, we may be able to identify areas where fraud is occurring and track the money to uncover the perpetrators.
